datasets.title: HYG star catalogue v4.4 (hyg_v44.csv.gz)
datasets.attribution: HYG star catalogue v4.4 by David Nash (astronexus), https://codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg, CC BY-SA 4.0
datasets.note: The release of 2026-07-12 (commit 53e3df3), 119,614 rows (the Sun included), 33,929,696 B unzipped. Fetched by mise run datasets:fetch, never committed (ADR-137); only its subset is served.

datasets.title: HYG v4.4, naked-eye stars (mag 6.5 and brighter)
datasets.attribution: Derived from the HYG star catalogue v4.4 by David Nash (astronexus), https://codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg, CC BY-SA 4.0
datasets.transform: The 8,920 stars with mag <= 6.5 other than the Sun, in the release's order, columns id, ra (hours), dec, mag, ci, proper, con, values as the release writes them (scripts/datasets.mjs hygSubset).
datasets.note: Served by the site at data/hyg/hyg-v44-mag6.5.csv with its notice beside it; 155,945 B gzip -9 (zlib level 9, measured 2026-10-23). ShareAlike: never in a crate or the npm package (REQ-DATASET-030).
